p1.explanation: Real. New Jersey 101.5 reports Springsteen told a MoMA film benefit that seeing 'Jaws' in 1975 spoiled night swimming at the Jersey Shore.
p1.con_line_false_alarm: Real. The Boss vs. a rubber shark. I couldn't write that.

p2.explanation: Real, from New Jersey 101.5 on Nov 12: a cargo ship struck the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge and left it unable to close. No injuries were reported.
p2.con_line_false_alarm: Real. A drawbridge stuck open is very Jersey, and very true.

p3.explanation: Real. It's Berlin, New Jersey, a few miles from Camden, where RCA-Victor was born. A Victor Museum opened there, electric piano that 'sort of works' included.
p3.con_line_false_alarm: Real. Berlin is in South Jersey. The headline just let you assume Germany.

p4.explanation: Real, and the rate comes with its denominator: 56.9 incidents per 1,000 drivers. The columnist even points out the study is built on insurance-quote data.
p4.con_line_false_alarm: Real. I'd never insult Jersey drivers. They'd find me.

p5.explanation: Real. New Jersey 101.5 quotes the caption on the seal video Jon Stewart posted, then matches the spot to the waters near Sandy Hook.
p5.con_line_false_alarm: Real. Three exclamation points and still true.

con_line_clean: Nothing doctored today. Jersey did all the work. All you had to do was believe it.
